title: Preparation of Multimode NOON States via Floquet-Engineered Conditional Chiral Excitation
summary: The NOON states possess Heisenberg-limited phase sensitivity and are crucial for quantum-enhanced metrology. In our work, we develop a Floquet-engineered conditional-routing framework in which a $d$-level quantum controller mediates the dynamics of $d$ bosonic modes. For an arbitrary odd dimension $d=2s+1$, the $d$-level system can act as a ``quantum knob" by tuning its initial states to coherently control the direction of chiral excitation flow, such that different controller eigenstates generate distinct cyclic-routing branches of the bosonic excitations.
